title: Truchas 2D VOF simulation input
description: Complete input for a two-dimensional volume-of-fluid advection simulation with a prescribed velocity field.

vof-model.description: VOF tracking algorithm, geometry mode, and prescribed velocity.

initial-regions.description: Named geometric regions used to initialize one volume-fraction component per region. Region order determines the component order.

initial-region-refinement-level.description: Maximum recursive refinement level used to estimate initial region volume fractions. The default is 6.

initial-time.description: Simulation time at which the initial volume fractions are established. The default is zero.

output-times.description: Output schedule. At least one expanded output time must be later than initial-time.

final-time.description: Optional final simulation time. It must be greater than initial-time and no earlier than the last output time; if omitted, it equals the last output time.

algorithm.description: Volume-fraction tracking algorithm. The geometric algorithm reconstructs bounded material volumes; the simple algorithm transports face fluxes directly. The default is geometric.

axisymmetric.description: Interpret the 2D mesh as an axisymmetric r-z mesh when computing volumes and fluxes. The default is false.

velocity.description: Prescribed velocity field. It may be a numeric vector or an inline vector-function definition, and must evaluate to exactly two components.
